frozen_mock_trade_policy.future_use: Keep prior frozen pick-containing mock trades untouched and use them only as external post-selection evidence after a successor study freezes an eligible candidate.
frozen_mock_trade_policy.reason_deferred: V5 produced no eligible candidate to replay.

future_research_constraints.prospective_clean_class_note: The 2024 rookie class is not yet a complete H3 outcome class as of the V5 closeout and may be reserved by a future preregistration as prospective clean H3 validation once its third NFL season is complete.
future_research_constraints.reason: Validation has been opened. Any new candidate family, expanded fitted round scope, or structural constraint must be preregistered as a separate study.
future_research_constraints.recommended_question: Can an expanded draft-pick Fundamental Value curve covering the R1/R2-to-R3 boundary (and, if preregistered, the audited R1-R4 scope) preserve monotonic continuity while retaining the substantial historical-outcome scale improvement observed in V5?
future_research_constraints.validation_contamination_note: The 2022-2023 H3 validation outcomes are no longer fresh for designing or selecting a successor family. A successor study must explicitly account for that fact rather than treating them as untouched holdout.

next_action: Archive/freeze V5. Open a separately preregistered successor draft-pick structural-continuity study before any additional fitting.

c2_isolation.description: C2 passed every preregistered eligibility gate except all-18-cell monotonicity.

c3_isolation.description: C3 had the lowest validation H3 O2 MAE of the frozen candidates but failed all-18-cell monotonicity and mature-H4 robustness.

primary_findings.evidence: All three frozen candidates improved H3 O2 validation macro MAE by far more than the preregistered 5% gate and improved both 2022 and 2023 versus C0.
primary_findings.structural_boundary_interpretation: The V5 no-candidate result is driven primarily by the requirement to splice materially lower fitted R1/R2 values onto untouched deployed R3-R6 values. For C2, the sole failed eligibility gate is the resulting R2-to-R3 upward discontinuity.
